svg.text: Market St · shops where they serve
The park-side row holds the nature shops (florist, beekeeping, butterflies, birds, pet store, mushrooms), then gems,
armor, clothes and skate by the skate extension. The Hudson row holds the town places (bank, hotel, bar, theatre,
playhouse, art museum, books, arcade) and the water: fish market and fishing at the pier. The way to the Hudson is twice
as wide. The park's west gate opens onto the apartment street. The flea market takes the lot behind the diner. Black
market in the alley later; the bath house is where ghosts come back.
CENTRAL PARK (as it is today, 240 × 184 m, walled)
FORCEFIELD · the park goes on north
